card.name: Start of a new item after a heading
card.fires_on: The first character of a new item right after a drug-name heading, a number, or an initial. Examples are the first letter after a brand name, a leading digit before a decimal point, and the period after a number or initial.

modes.label: Digit before decimal
modes.description: A leading 0 or 1 in a table of decimal numbers.

modes.label: First letter after drug name
modes.description: The first letter of a section title right after a brand name.
modes.example: WELLBUTRIN SR<< S>>ustained-Release Tablets When switching patients

modes.label: Period after number or initial
modes.description: A period following a list number or an author initial.

card.plain: It fires on the first character of a new item, such as a table number, a list number or the start of a section title.
